description: A schema describing the excitation energy of a nuclear level.

offset.description: This field is for floating levels which do not have a known excitation energy, i.e. they should up like 'X+20' in Nuclear Data Sheets.  This field holds that letter (X,Y,...) or the proton/neutron separation energy for unbound levels.

isFixed.description: Indicates that this level is held fixed when minimizing to gamma-ray energies.  Absence indicates 'false.'
